[LNAM.7.2] The `::` operator is a compile-time construct producing
already-converted runtime values and does **not** change the wire encoding.
NFC identifier bytes do not change it either: ASCII identifiers are
NFC-invariant, and a non-ASCII NFC schema name is an opaque interned string
to any runtime — the correctness gate is the compiler version that implies
the pinned Unicode version ([LNAM.2.2.5], [LNAM.7.3]), not the DSC format; consistent with the base container contract
(`RDSC.10.4`/`10.5` — accept-any-minor / skip-unknown).
